AgentStep.description: One step the cloud really ran to build this insight. Counts and categories only; never record content.

items.description: how many records / findings / nodes this step handled
items.title: Items

AgentStep.title: AgentStep

Course.description:
How the record has moved against the person's own usual: what moved first, what followed, what has come
back, what has not. Temporal order only, never a cause. Computed by code from the daily series.

back.description: of those, how many are back within usual
back.title: Back

low_date.description: the day most measures were away from usual
low_date.title: Low Date

moved.description: measures that moved away from usual in this spell
moved.title: Moved

Course.title: Course

CourseEvent.description: One dated point in the course of change. Text, dates and numbers are written by code.
CourseEvent.title: CourseEvent

baseline_ready.description: at least one measure has a personal baseline
baseline_ready.title: Baseline Ready

day_of_record.description: calendar days since the first observation
day_of_record.title: Day Of Record

early_baseline.description: baselines in use are provisional (young record)
early_baseline.title: Early Baseline

simulated.description: the record contains simulated observations (envelope sim flag); the same value as Consensus.simulated and RecordCitation.simulated; per-type counts show how many
simulated.title: Simulated

DayAccount.description:
One day in plain words, built by code from every source: what was done, what was away from usual, how the
reflection went (level and themes only, when shared).
DayAccount.title: DayAccount

trend.description: this week vs the week before across this group's measures
trend.title: Trend

sufficient.description: enough recent usable data for this group to give a verdict
sufficient.title: Sufficient

HeardTone.description:
How a conversation sounded to the model that was in it, reported through the `feel` tool. An observation
by a model, never a measurement and never a state. `model_heard`: the native-audio voice model heard the
person speak. `model_read`: it went by their typed or transcribed words only.

moments.description: how many times a feeling was noticed in that conversation
moments.title: Moments

HeardTone.title: HeardTone

HelpEffect.description: What the learner has seen for one activity. A reported response, not proof that the activity caused it.
HelpEffect.title: HelpEffect

InsightChange.description: One thing that is different on a day, pointing at its node. Text and order are written by code.

tag.description: where it sits in the order of the change, when the course has one: 'first to move', '1 day after the first change' (order in time, never cause)
tag.title: Tag

InsightChange.title: InsightChange

InsightDomain.description:
A neighbourhood of the graph: what a group of nodes is about, and where it sits around the person. Declared
once in config/kaiku.toml [graph]; the same for every person.
InsightDomain.title: InsightDomain

on.description: the days this link is about, oldest first: the day a measure followed, the days two measures were away together, the day it came back
on.title: On

tag.description: a few words for a badge: '+1 day', 'first'
tag.title: Tag

InsightGraph.description:
What a practitioner may see of what Kaiku has learned: signal groups, measures, observed activities, routines
and what helped. Built from observations; conversation counts join only when the person shares. Never people,
places, likes, plans, memories or transcripts.

days.description: every calendar day from the first to the last day with data inside the graph's window, oldest first
days.title: Days

shared.description: the person shares conversation-derived activity counts with the care team
shared.title: Shared

InsightGraph.title: InsightGraph

InsightGraphDay.description: One day of the graph's record: what changed that day and how many measures were away from usual.

away.description: measures away from their usual that day
away.title: Away

recorded.description: at least one observation or care action that day
recorded.title: Recorded

InsightGraphDay.title: InsightGraphDay

domain.description: id of the `InsightGraph.domains` entry this node is about; empty for the person and the signal groups (who sent it is not what it is about)
domain.title: Domain

evidence.description: recorded days / observations / attempts behind this node
evidence.title: Evidence

layer.description: learned = found in this person's record; structure = how the record is organised
layer.title: Layer

InsightNodeDay.description:
What one graph node has on one day of the record, by the same code as the course, the trends band and the
daily account. A day with nothing for the node has no entry.

text.description: one plain clause by code: '2 of 5, below their usual 4 of 5'
text.title: Text

tone.description: measure: that day's reading against that day's own usual (worse = away from usual, better = beyond usual on the favourable side, similar = within usual, unknown = no personal usual yet); routine: similar = kept, worse = missed on a recorded day; every other kind: unknown (recorded, not judged)
tone.title: Tone

InsightNodeDay.title: InsightNodeDay

caveat.description: how far the reported responses can be trusted
caveat.title: Caveat

MetricComparison.description: One measure: this week vs the week before vs the person's own usual. Medians of recorded days.

early_baseline.description: the usual is a provisional baseline of a young record
early_baseline.title: Early Baseline

sustained.description: the rule engine's reading over recent days (criteria thresholds), not a one-week difference
sustained.title: Sustained

usual.description: personal baseline median for the latest scored day
usual.title: Usual

MetricComparison.title: MetricComparison

captured_by.description: envelope sources that sent it (hub, phone, …)
captured_by.title: Captured By

simulated.description: how many of these observations carry sim=true
simulated.title: Simulated

PatientReview.description: Gemma's review of the person: what changed, what it likely means, what to consider. Never decides state.

day_of_record.description: calendar days since the first observation
day_of_record.title: Day Of Record

early_record.description: baselines are provisional or missing: read every comparison with lower confidence
early_record.title: Early Record

fallback_reason.description: content-free category when the template answered instead of the model, e.g. not_requested | provider_unavailable | invalid_json | no_valid_findings | cooldown
fallback_reason.title: Fallback Reason

overview.description: Gemma's reading of the whole record: what started, what followed, what has come back, what has not. Null when the template answered; `PatientInsight.course.summary` is the code-written arc
overview.title: Overview

overview_cites.description: evidence ids the overview rests on
overview_cites.title: Overview Cites

PatientReview.title: PatientReview

back_in_range.description: metric names back within usual after a spell
back_in_range.title: Back In Range

changed.description: metric names worse than the week before
changed.title: Changed

early_baseline.description: at least one usual here is a provisional baseline
early_baseline.title: Early Baseline

improved.description: metric names better than the week before
improved.title: Improved

since_low.description: against the spell's low point, e.g. '12 of 18 measures back within usual since the low on 8 Nov'; empty when nothing moved
since_low.title: Since Low

still_away.description: metric names still away from usual
still_away.title: Still Away

heard.description: as reported by the model in the conversation

ReflectionOverview.description:
Reflections with Kaiku at summary level: how many sounded low / neutral / bright and what they were about.
Present only when the person shares with the care team. Never their words.

declined.description: the person asked to stop or did not want to talk
declined.title: Declined

reflections.description: reflections with a summary in the last 7 days
reflections.title: Reflections

summary.description: the fortnight in one or two sentences; counts are 7 days
summary.title: Summary

themes.description: theme -> reflections it came up in
themes.title: Themes

tone_summary.description: how they sounded, by provenance: tone of their words, and tone as reported by the model in the conversation
tone_summary.title: Tone Summary

ReflectionOverview.title: ReflectionOverview

ReviewFinding.description:
One claim in the review. `meaning`/`consider` are interpretation (Gemma when `by` = gemma: validated, no
numbers, no state words); `facts` are rendered by code from the cited records and carry every number.

facts.description: verified record facts, numbers rendered by code
facts.title: Facts

meaning.description: what it likely means, in plain words
meaning.title: Meaning

ReviewFinding.title: ReviewFinding

Routine.description: A rhythm found BY CODE in the last weeks (obs, and conversations for the person or when shared).

activity.description: ritual | walk | drum | breathe | checkin | laptop | play | sleep
activity.title: Activity

this_week.description: days with it in the last 7 days
this_week.title: This Week

usual_time.description: local HH:MM (median of the usual weeks)
usual_time.title: Usual Time

Routine.title: Routine

StateDay.description: The deterministic consensus replayed for one day of the record.

early.description: fewer days on record than min_history_days_for_stable: never stable yet
early.title: Early

StateDay.title: StateDay

description:
GET /v1/patients/{id}/insight — everything the intelligence layer knows that a practitioner may see, in one
payload: Gemma's evidence-cited review, the steps that produced it, week-over-week comparison, the learned
routine, the permitted graph and data coverage. State comes from the deterministic consensus only.

day_of_record.description: calendar days since the first observation
day_of_record.title: Day Of Record

early_record.description: provisional or missing baselines: lower confidence
early_record.title: Early Record

state_history.description: oldest first, one row per day replayed
state_history.title: State History

status_line.description: one statement by code that reconciles the rule state with the course: when it was raised, what has come back, why it still shows
status_line.title: Status Line

title: PatientInsight
